## Install

Download `Zygor-IP-latest.zip`, extract it outside your WoW folder, close WoW and run `Install-Zygor.cmd`. It downloads this commit of `main` from GitHub, verifies every file and installs `ZygorGuidesViewerRM`; the old folder is backed up and SavedVariables are kept.

Use it with the matching server from the [mod-playerbots-portable Latest release](https://github.com/Syntax555/mod-playerbots-portable/releases/latest). Changes compared to [ErebusAres/ZygorGuidesRemaster-3.3.5a_WOTLK](https://github.com/ErebusAres/ZygorGuidesRemaster-3.3.5a_WOTLK) are listed in this fork's [README](https://github.com/Syntax555/ZygorGuidesRemaster-3.3.5a_WOTLK#mod-playerbots-portable-fork).
